limits: All five source frames retain their actual counted lengths. Part4 has202 slots, independently of its unresolved printed length annotation.
The native five-part plaintext ends and begins across boundaries: AEUSSERST / UNERWUENSCHT, VORKOMMANDOS / SIND, KONSTANTA U / MEDGIDIA. No joining letters are invented.
The fully erased date position in VOR?2X11 is left open across all36 symbols. The earlier12X11 field does not independently certify that missing digit.
WALACHEIEBENE is a lexical completion of visible WALACHEI??E?E; its source-compatible E/B/N fills are separately recorded.
The source spelling KONSTANTA and abbreviations ET VERW/O K M are retained. Reference digits are not relabeled.
Part4 has overlapping typewritten rows; all transcribed coordinate glyphs are visible in the dedicated high-resolution crop. No opaque mark was silently read from desired plaintext.
